security_code.description: Exact requested security code; do not infer a different issuer.
security_code.title: Security Code

company_name_ja.description: Japanese company name stated in the latest supplied filing.
company_name_ja.title: Company Name Ja

company_name_en.description: English company name stated in the supplied filings, or a faithful romanization when no English name is shown.
company_name_en.title: Company Name En

latest_filename.description: Exact authoritative filename of the filing identified as latest.
latest_filename.title: Latest Filename

latest_period_ja.description: Concise Japanese reporting-period label for the latest filing.
latest_period_ja.title: Latest Period Ja

evidence_id.description: Unique stable ID formatted as <source_filename>:sNNNN, using a four-digit sequence within the response.
evidence_id.title: Evidence Id

source_filename.description: Exact source_filename from the metadata preceding the cited PDF.
source_filename.title: Source Filename

pdf_page.description: Physical 1-indexed PDF page containing the quote; never a printed footer, contents-page, or document page label.
pdf_page.title: Pdf Page

exact_quote_ja.description: Verbatim contiguous Japanese sentence or short passage that contains the material facts, figures, dates, qualifiers, and causal wording used.
exact_quote_ja.title: Exact Quote Ja

period_label_ja.description: Concise Japanese period label suitable for a citation.
period_label_ja.title: Period Label Ja

statement_type.description: Nature of the quoted source statement, not the analyst's tone.

source_section.description: Concise filing section or table name where the quote appears.
source_section.title: Source Section

tags.description: Optional short topical labels; use an empty list when unnecessary.
tags.title: Tags

ModelManagementConsistency.description: Model inputs only; Python calculates the published score.

components.description: Exactly one component for each of the four required consistency dimensions.
components.title: Components

overall_rationale_ja.description: Concise synthesis of the company's management consistency across the selected trend period, including the strongest evidence for and against consistency and any important qualifications.
overall_rationale_ja.title: Overall Rationale Ja

ModelManagementConsistency.title: ModelManagementConsistency

ModelManagementConsistencyComponent.description: One model-rated input to the locally calculated consistency score.

rating.description: Evidence-based ordinal rating: 0 materially inconsistent, 1 weak, 2 mixed, 3 generally consistent, or 4 highly consistent. Use null when longitudinal evidence is insufficient.
rating.title: Rating

evidence_sufficiency.description: Whether the selected filings provide enough longitudinal evidence to assign this component a substantive rating.
evidence_sufficiency.title: Evidence Sufficiency

rationale_ja.description: Concise Japanese explanation comparing what management said with later actions, outcomes, revisions, or explanations. State both the strongest supporting evidence and any material counterevidence, and compare targets with results using the same scope and time horizon.
rationale_ja.title: Rationale Ja

evidence_ids.description: Evidence IDs from management-discussion passages that support the rating or explain why the evidence is insufficient.
evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids

ModelManagementConsistencyComponent.title: ModelManagementConsistencyComponent

ResearchBusinessDriver.description: One comparable business driver extracted from the selected filings.

canonical_tag.description: Short reusable driver category such as customer_demand, pricing, material_costs, labor_costs, interest_rates, foreign_exchange, utilization, regulation, technology_investment, or other.
canonical_tag.title: Canonical Tag

affected_area_ja.description: Business, segment, margin, cash-flow, or balance-sheet area affected.
affected_area_ja.title: Affected Area Ja

summary_ja.description: Concise explanation of the operating or financial transmission mechanism, including material qualifications.
summary_ja.title: Summary Ja

ResearchBusinessDriver.title: ResearchBusinessDriver

ResearchCommitmentRecord.description: A forecast, target, or commitment connected to a later observable outcome.

outcome_ja.description: Later result or a concise statement that the outcome is not yet observable in the selected filings.
outcome_ja.title: Outcome Ja

evidence_ids.description: Evidence for the original statement and, when observable, its revision or later outcome.
evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids

ResearchCommitmentRecord.title: ResearchCommitmentRecord

ResearchThemeRecord.description: A recurring or changing management-commentary theme.

interpretation_ja.description: What remained consistent or changed, what management subsequently did, and what outcome or unresolved tension is visible.
interpretation_ja.title: Interpretation Ja

ResearchThemeRecord.title: ResearchThemeRecord
